claims.quote: Fire and Blood,George R. R. Martin,255144.0,44.0,6.13,2.32,0.6,1.72

claims.claim: The same dataset gives Fire and Blood a passive-voice rate of 6.13%, the lowest of the nine Martin titles it lists.
claims.source: prosecraft.io library figures as scraped in the Genre_Prediction dataset

claims.claim: LightSail's catalogue record classifies Fire & Blood as Non-Fiction, while its record for A Game of Thrones classifies that book as Fiction.
claims.source: LightSail Education catalogue records for Fire & Blood and A Game of Thrones
claims.quote: Non-Fiction
